intent: Actions or value menu from a button, field, or nav trigger.
useWhen: A button that opens a short list of actions
Row actions in a DataTable via Cell type=actionMenu
doNotUseWhen: Choosing one value in a form — use Select (it composes this with triggerStyle=field)
Searchable commands — use Command in a Modal
Top-of-page site nav with dropdowns — use NavigationMenu (it composes this with triggerStyle=nav)

describedBy.note: Field wires hint and error ids onto the trigger

trigger.note: Kit Button label. Omit for icon-only; then ariaLabel is required.

iconStart.note: Lucide name on the kit Button

items.label: string
items.href: string? renders a when set and not disabled
items.selected: boolean? Check when true unless checkbox is set.
items.checkbox: boolean? Compose kit Checkbox (visual, inert). Not DropdownMenuCheckboxItem.

triggerStyle.note: button is kit Button. field is a full-width control with ChevronsUpDown. Select uses field. nav is a ghost text control with ChevronDown; NavigationMenu uses nav.

iconEnd.note: Lucide name on a field trigger (default ChevronsUpDown) or kit Button trigger.

columns.note: 2 uses a CSS grid panel, min-width 28rem. 1 stays a list.

closeOnSelect.note: false keeps the menu open. Select multiple uses false.

triggerMuted.note: Muted field trigger text for a placeholder.

triggerBadge.note: Kit Badge on a field trigger next to the label, e.g. +2. Select overflow uses this.

searchable.note: Kit Input at the top of the panel. Filters item labels. Select searchable uses this.

requirements: Trigger has aria-haspopup=menu, aria-expanded, aria-controls. button is kit Button; field is a field control; nav is a ghost text control
Items are role=menuitem, or menuitemcheckbox when checkbox is set. aria-disabled when disabled. With href and not disabled, the item is an a
Escape and outside click close; arrows move; Tab closes. Search Input is focused first when searchable
Item with submenu has aria-haspopup=menu and ChevronRight; ArrowRight opens, ArrowLeft closes

doNot: Do not invent DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuSeparator, DropdownMenuShortcut, DropdownMenuGroup, DropdownMenuCheckboxItem, DropdownMenuRadioItem, DropdownMenuSub, or DropdownMenuPortal
Do not use Select for actions from a button
Do not use Command or Modal for a small action menu
Do not invent DropdownMenuSub — nest groups on the item, one level
Do not invent CheckboxItem or RadioItem cousins — compose kit Checkbox on the item
Do not use radix, cmdk, or @base-ui/react
snippet:
<DropdownMenu
  trigger="Open"
  groups={[{
    heading: "My Account",
    items: [
      { id: "profile", label: "Profile", shortcut: "⇧⌘P" },
      { id: "invite", label: "Invite users", submenu: [{ items: [{ id: "email", label: "Email" }] }] },
    ],
  }]}
  onSelect={(id) => {}}
/>
